description: No-knowledge client proposed complex derivative — R1+R7 hard fail → UNSUITABLE (score 100, hard-fail gate overrides)
client_narrative: Pedro Nunes is 28 years old. He earns a gross monthly salary of approximately 2,500 euros. He has 15,000 euros in a current account and wants to invest 10,000 euros over a 2-year period in something that could give him big returns. He admits he has never invested in anything before — no stocks, no funds, nothing at all: 'I honestly don't know much about financial products, this would be my very first time.' He describes himself as growth-oriented and gives his risk appetite a 6 out of 10. This 10,000 euros is money he has set aside purely for speculation and he is completely fine with losing every cent of it.
product_narrative: The product is a single-stock call option on a large-cap European company traded on a regulated exchange. The holder acquires the right but not the obligation to buy shares at a fixed strike price on a defined expiry date. The entire premium paid may be lost if the option expires out of the money. As a derivative instrument with a complex, non-linear payoff profile, it requires advanced product knowledge and is classified as complex under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). It is a short-term speculative instrument, not designed for long-term holding.
